jobs.list.title: List jobs
jobs.list.description: List public job postings via GET /v0/postings/{site}.

opportunities.list.title: List opportunities
opportunities.list.description: List candidate opportunities via authenticated GET /v1/opportunities. Optional limit, offset, email, tag, stageId, postingId, and archived filters.

opportunities.get.title: Get opportunity
opportunities.get.description: Fetch a single opportunity via authenticated GET /v1/opportunities/{id}.

opportunities.interviews.list.title: List opportunity interviews
opportunities.interviews.list.description: List interviews for an opportunity via authenticated GET /v1/opportunities/{id}/interviews. Optional limit and offset.

opportunities.feedback.list.title: List opportunity feedback
opportunities.feedback.list.description: List feedback forms for an opportunity via authenticated GET /v1/opportunities/{id}/feedback. Optional limit and offset.

stages.list.title: List stages
stages.list.description: List pipeline stages via authenticated GET /v1/stages. Optional limit and offset.

users.list.title: List users
users.list.description: List account users via authenticated GET /v1/users. Optional limit, offset, email, and accessRole filters.

opportunities.update_stage.title: Update opportunity stage
opportunities.update_stage.description: Move an opportunity to another pipeline stage via authenticated PUT /v1/opportunities/{id}/stage. Connector input stageId maps to Lever body field stage (Stage UID per official docs). EffectPolicy Reconcile observes via opportunities.get.

stageId.description: Destination stage UID; sent as Lever request body field stage.

opportunities.archive.title: Archive opportunity
opportunities.archive.description: Archive (or unarchive) an opportunity via authenticated PUT /v1/opportunities/{id}/archived. Body field reason is the archive reason UID; null unarchives. EffectPolicy Reconcile observes via opportunities.get.

reason.description: Archive reason UID; null unarchives an already-archived opportunity.

cleanInterviews.description: Remove pending interviews when archiving (Lever default false).

requisitionId.description: Optional requisition UID when archiving as Hired.

archive_reasons.list.title: List archive reasons
archive_reasons.list.description: List account archive reasons via authenticated GET /v1/archive_reasons. Optional type filter (hired | non-hired), limit, and offset.

type.description: Optional filter for archive reason type.

offset.description: Opaque pagination offset token from a prior next field.

opportunities.update.title: Update opportunity
opportunities.update.description: Update an opportunity contact via authenticated PUT /v1/contacts/{contactId} (contact resolved from GET /v1/opportunities/{id}); tags go through POST /v1/opportunities/{id}/addTags. There is no generic PUT /opportunities/{id}. EffectPolicy Reconcile observes via opportunities.get.

emails.description: Email addresses to set on the contact.

tags.description: Tags to add on the opportunity via addTags (additive; not a full replace).

opportunity.description: Normalized opportunity after EffectPolicy Reconcile via opportunities.get.

candidates.get.title: Get candidate
candidates.get.description: Fetch a Lever opportunity as a candidate via authenticated GET /v1/opportunities/{id}. Distinct from opportunities.get: returns a candidate-shaped record.

interviews.list.title: List interviews
interviews.list.description: List interviews for an opportunity via authenticated GET /v1/opportunities/{id}/interviews. Requires opportunityId. Optional limit and offset.

interviews.get.title: Get interview
interviews.get.description: Fetch a single interview via authenticated GET /v1/opportunities/{id}/interviews/{interviewId}.

offers.list.title: List offers
offers.list.description: List offers for an opportunity via authenticated GET /v1/opportunities/{id}/offers. Requires opportunityId.

offers.get.title: Get offer
offers.get.description: Fetch a single offer by listing GET /v1/opportunities/{id}/offers and filtering on offerId client-side. Lever has no single-offer GET in the Offers reference.

postings.list.title: List postings
postings.list.description: List authenticated job postings via GET /v1/postings. Distinct from public jobs.list. Optional state, limit, and offset filters.

postings.get.title: Get posting
postings.get.description: Fetch a single authenticated posting via GET /v1/postings/{id}. Distinct from public jobs.list.

notes.list.title: List notes
notes.list.description: List notes for an opportunity via authenticated GET /v1/opportunities/{id}/notes. Requires opportunityId.

users.get.title: Get user
users.get.description: Fetch a single user via authenticated GET /v1/users/{id}.

requisitions.list.title: List requisitions
requisitions.list.description: List requisitions via authenticated GET /v1/requisitions. Optional limit and offset.

feedback.get.title: Get feedback
feedback.get.description: Fetch a single feedback form via authenticated GET /v1/opportunities/{id}/feedback/{feedbackId}.

opportunities.create.title: Create opportunity
opportunities.create.description: Create a candidate opportunity via authenticated POST /v1/opportunities?perform_as={performAs} (JSON only; resume multipart is out of scope). Lever dedupes by email or contactId onto an existing contact. Result surfaces the created opportunity UID (data.id) as top-level id. No EffectPolicy: a retried POST would create a duplicate opportunity.

performAs.description: User UID to perform_as (query; required by Lever). Defaults the creator and owner.

tags.description: Tags to apply; unknown tags are created.

sources.description: Sources to apply; unknown sources are created.

owner.description: Owner user UID; defaults to the perform_as user.

stage.description: Stage UID; Lever defaults to New Lead when omitted.

postings.description: Posting UIDs. Lever rejects more than one posting per request.

contactId.description: Existing contact UID to attach this opportunity to; sent as Lever body field contact.

opportunities.add_tags.title: Add opportunity tags
opportunities.add_tags.description: Add tags to an opportunity via authenticated POST /v1/opportunities/{id}/addTags. EffectPolicy Reconcile observes via opportunities.get.

opportunities.remove_tags.title: Remove opportunity tags
opportunities.remove_tags.description: Remove tags from an opportunity via authenticated POST /v1/opportunities/{id}/removeTags. EffectPolicy Reconcile observes via opportunities.get.

opportunities.add_links.title: Add contact links by opportunity
opportunities.add_links.description: Add links to the opportunity contact via authenticated POST /v1/opportunities/{id}/addLinks. Links live on the contact; the opportunity object has no links field, so the observe confirms the opportunity still resolves (durability only). EffectPolicy Reconcile observes via opportunities.get.

opportunities.remove_links.title: Remove contact links by opportunity
opportunities.remove_links.description: Remove links from the opportunity contact via authenticated POST /v1/opportunities/{id}/removeLinks. Links live on the contact; the opportunity object has no links field, so the observe confirms the opportunity still resolves (durability only). EffectPolicy Reconcile observes via opportunities.get.

opportunities.add_sources.title: Add opportunity sources
opportunities.add_sources.description: Add sources to an opportunity via authenticated POST /v1/opportunities/{id}/addSources. EffectPolicy Reconcile observes via opportunities.get.

opportunities.remove_sources.title: Remove opportunity sources
opportunities.remove_sources.description: Remove sources from an opportunity via authenticated POST /v1/opportunities/{id}/removeSources. EffectPolicy Reconcile observes via opportunities.get.

notes.create.title: Create note
notes.create.description: Create a note on an opportunity via authenticated POST /v1/opportunities/{opportunityId}/notes. Optional noteId (query note_id) adds a threaded comment to an existing note. Lever returns only data.noteId (no id), so no EffectPolicy is declared.

secret.description: Restrict visibility to SIP users and mentioned users.

notifyFollowers.description: Notify all users following the candidate.

createdAt.description: Historical create time (ms epoch); cannot be in the future.

noteId.description: Existing note UID to add a threaded comment to (query note_id).

notes.get.title: Get note
notes.get.description: Fetch a single note via authenticated GET /v1/opportunities/{opportunityId}/notes/{noteId}.

notes.update.title: Update note
notes.update.description: Replace an API-created note via authenticated PUT /v1/opportunities/{opportunityId}/notes/{noteId}. Atomic: values replaces every comment in the note thread. No EffectPolicy (no observe GET for notes on tip).

values.description: Comments that replace the note thread (note field type only).

user.description: User UID who wrote the comment.

notes.delete.title: Delete note
notes.delete.description: Delete an API-created note via authenticated DELETE /v1/opportunities/{opportunityId}/notes/{noteId} (204). Notes created in the Lever app cannot be deleted via API.

sources.list.title: List sources
sources.list.description: List account candidate sources with counts via authenticated GET /v1/sources. Optional limit and offset.

offset.description: Opaque pagination offset token from a prior next field.

tags.list.title: List tags
tags.list.description: List account candidate tags with counts via authenticated GET /v1/tags. Optional limit and offset.

offset.description: Opaque pagination offset token from a prior next field.

stages.get.title: Get stage
stages.get.description: Fetch a single pipeline stage via authenticated GET /v1/stages/{stageId}.

referrals.list.title: List referrals
referrals.list.description: List referral forms for an opportunity via authenticated GET /v1/opportunities/{opportunityId}/referrals. Optional limit and offset.

offset.description: Opaque pagination offset token from a prior next field.

panels.list.title: List panels
panels.list.description: List interview panels for an opportunity via authenticated GET /v1/opportunities/{opportunityId}/panels.

panels.get.title: Get panel
panels.get.description: Fetch a single interview panel via authenticated GET /v1/opportunities/{opportunityId}/panels/{panelId}. Returns timezone, interviews, applications, note, externalUrl, feedbackReminder and related fields for Reconcile observe.

panels.create.title: Create panel
panels.create.description: Create an externally-managed interview panel via authenticated POST /v1/opportunities/{opportunityId}/panels?perform_as=. Surfaces data.id as id. No EffectPolicy (create omits effect keys).

performAs.description: User UID to perform_as (query; required by Lever).

timezone.description: IANA timezone for the panel (e.g. America/Los_Angeles).

interviews.description: Non-empty interview objects for the panel.

applications.description: Application UIDs; omit for all active.

panels.update.title: Update panel
panels.update.description: Update an externally-managed panel via authenticated PUT /v1/opportunities/{opportunityId}/panels/{panelId}?perform_as=. Atomic PUT (omitted fields cleared). EffectPolicy Reconcile observes via panels.get (exact: GET returns timezone/interviews/applications/note/externalUrl/feedbackReminder).

performAs.description: User UID to perform_as (query; required by Lever).

timezone.description: IANA timezone for the panel (e.g. America/Los_Angeles).

interviews.description: Non-empty interview objects for the panel.

applications.description: Application UIDs; omit for all active.

panels.delete.title: Delete panel
panels.delete.description: Delete an interview panel via authenticated DELETE /v1/opportunities/{opportunityId}/panels/{panelId}?perform_as= (204). Missing panel → CONNECTOR_UPSTREAM_ERROR.

performAs.description: User UID to perform_as (query; required by Lever).

interviews.create.title: Create interview
interviews.create.description: Create an interview on a panel via authenticated POST /v1/opportunities/{opportunityId}/interviews?perform_as=. Surfaces data.id as id. No EffectPolicy (create omits effect keys).

performAs.description: User UID to perform_as (query; required by Lever).

interviews.update.title: Update interview
interviews.update.description: Update an interview via authenticated PUT /v1/opportunities/{opportunityId}/interviews/{interviewId}?perform_as=. EffectPolicy Reconcile observes via tip interviews.get.

performAs.description: User UID to perform_as (query; required by Lever).

interviews.delete.title: Delete interview
interviews.delete.description: Delete an interview via authenticated DELETE /v1/opportunities/{opportunityId}/interviews/{interviewId}?perform_as= (204). Missing interview → CONNECTOR_UPSTREAM_ERROR.

performAs.description: User UID to perform_as (query; required by Lever).

requisitions.get.title: Get requisition
requisitions.get.description: Fetch a single requisition via authenticated GET /v1/requisitions/{requisitionId}. Returns requisitionCode/name/headcountTotal/status and related fields for Reconcile observe.

requisitions.create.title: Create requisition
requisitions.create.description: Create a requisition via authenticated POST /v1/requisitions. Surfaces data.id as id. No EffectPolicy (create omits effect keys).

requisitions.update.title: Update requisition
requisitions.update.description: Update a requisition via authenticated PUT /v1/requisitions/{requisitionId} (atomic). EffectPolicy Reconcile observes via requisitions.get (exact: GET returns all writable fields).

requisitions.delete.title: Delete requisition
requisitions.delete.description: Delete a requisition via authenticated DELETE /v1/requisitions/{requisitionId} (204). Missing requisition → CONNECTOR_UPSTREAM_ERROR.

resumes.list.title: List resumes
resumes.list.description: List resume metadata for an opportunity via authenticated GET /v1/opportunities/{opportunityId}/resumes. Binary download is out of scope.

files.list.title: List files
files.list.description: List file metadata for an opportunity via authenticated GET /v1/opportunities/{opportunityId}/files. Binary download is out of scope.

files.get.title: Get file
files.get.description: Fetch file metadata (including downloadUrl) via authenticated GET /v1/opportunities/{opportunityId}/files/{fileId}. Does not download bytes.
